results.name: Cable Upright Row With Straight Bar
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the cable machine with a straight bar attached to the low pulley. Grasp the bar with both hands using an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar upwards towards your chin by bending your elbows and raising your upper arms, leading with your elbows, keeping the bar close to your body.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid using momentum.
Keep your elbows higher than your wrists throughout the movement.
Exhale as you pull the straight bar up and inhale as you lower it back down.
results.description: Cable Upright Row With Straight Bar is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Forearms.

results.name: Cable Y Raise
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with the pulleys set at the lowest position. Grasp a handle in each hand, holding the left handle with your right hand and the right handle with your left hand, so the cables cross in front of you.
Take a step back and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your back straight and arms extended down in front of you.
Raise the handles up and out to form a "Y" shape, keeping your arms straight but with a slight bend in the elbows. Lift until your arms are overhead.
Slowly lower the handles back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid using momentum.
Use a lighter weight to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you get stronger.
Exhale as you raise the handles and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Cable Y Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Cross Over Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart. Lean forward at your hips with a slight arch in your back.
Cross your arms and place your hands on your knees.
Engage your core and gently press your chest downward to feel the stretch in your shoulders and upper back.
Hold the stretch for the desired duration, then slowly return to a standing position.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Focus on keeping a slight arch in your back and avoid rounding your spine.
Perform the stretch with control to avoid overextending your shoulders.
Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch, inhaling through your nose and exhaling through your mouth.
results.description: Cross Over Shoulder Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Dumbbell Alternate Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Your palms should be facing forward, and your elbows should be bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and press the right dumbbell overhead until your arm is fully extended. Keep your left dumbbell in the starting position.
Lower the right dumbbell back to shoulder height in a controlled manner.
Repeat, alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to maintain tension in the muscles.
Breathe out as you press the dumbbell overhead and breathe in as you lower it.
Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Alternate Shoulder Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Alternate Side Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Your palms should be facing each other, and your elbows should be bent at a 60-degree angle and facing downward.
Press the right dumbbell overhead and slightly lean to the opposite side until your arm is fully extended.
Lower the right dumbbell back to shoulder height in a controlled manner and press the left dumbbell overhead and slightly to the side.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions, ensuring a smooth and controlled movement.
tips: Breathe out as you press the dumbbell overhead and breathe in as you lower it.
Maintain a controlled pace to maximize muscle engagement and avoid using momentum.
Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Alternate Side Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Alternating Arnold Press
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing your body and your elbows bent.
Press one dumbbell overhead while rotating your hand until your palm faces forward as your arm reaches full extension.
Lower the dumbbell back to shoulder height while rotating your hand until your palm faces your body again.
Repeat the movement with the opposite arm, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the non-working dumbbell at shoulder height while pressing the opposite arm.
Rotate your hand smoothly throughout the press instead of turning it all at once.
Press the dumbbell directly overhead without letting your elbow flare excessively.
Inhale as you lower the dumbbell and exhale as you press it overhead.
results.description: Dumbbell Alternating Arnold Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Dumbbell Armpit Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended and palms facing your body.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your armpits by bending your elbows. Your elbows should be pointing out to the sides.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position in a controlled manner. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders during the exercise.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees to reduce strain on your lower back.
Breathe out as you lift the dumbbells and breathe in as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Armpit Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Arnold Press (Front View)
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing each other and your elbows bent.
Engage your shoulders and rotate your palms to face forward as you press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Reverse the motion by lowering the dumbbells back to shoulder height while rotating your palms to face each other again.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, ensuring a smooth and controlled motion throughout the exercise.
tips: Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to maintain tension in the muscles.
Breathe out as you press the dumbbells overhead and breathe in as you lower them.
Maintain a controlled pace to maximize muscle engagement and avoid using momentum.
results.description: Dumbbell Arnold Press (Front View) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Arnold Press Seated
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing your body and your elbows bent. Your feet should be flat on the floor.
Engage your shoulders and rotate your palms to face forward as you press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Reverse the motion by lowering the dumbbells back to shoulder height while rotating your palms to face your body again.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, ensuring a smooth and controlled motion throughout the exercise.
tips: Keep your back pressed against the bench to maintain stability and prevent arching.
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to maintain tension in the muscles.
Breathe out as you press the dumbbells overhead and breathe in as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Arnold Press Seated is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Around the World
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging by your sides and palms facing forward.
Slowly raise both dumbbells outward to the sides, keeping your arms straight, until they reach shoulder height.
Continue lifting the dumbbells in a circular motion above your head until they meet at the top with your arms fully extended.
Reverse the motion, lowering the dumbbells back down in the same circular path until they are by your sides again. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
Use a controlled motion to prevent using momentum to lift the weights.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows to reduce stress on your joints.
results.description: Dumbbell Around the World is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Upper Back.
